## About Instant Grow

Instant Grow is a global online business formation platform that helps entrepreneurs, freelancers, e-commerce sellers, and investors form US LLCs, UK LTD companies, UAE Free Zone companies, and Oman LLCs — completely online, from anywhere in the world, in as little as 24 hours.

- **Website:** https://instantgrow.net
- **Primary language:** English (Arabic also supported)
- **Founded:** 2020
- **Companies formed:** 24,800+
- **Customer rating:** 4.9 / 5.0
- **Clients from:** 150+ countries
- **Support:** 24/7 via chat and email

---

## Core Services

### 1. US LLC Formation
Form a Wyoming or Delaware LLC from anywhere in the world.
- Included: State filing, Articles of Organization, Registered Agent (1 year), EIN from the IRS, Operating Agreement, US business mailing address.
- Formation time: 24–72 hours (express 24-hour available)
- No US residency or travel required
- Best for: e-commerce, Amazon FBA, SaaS, freelancers, international entrepreneurs
- Page: https://instantgrow.net/us-company

### 2. Wyoming LLC
Wyoming is the most popular US state for non-resident LLC formation.
- Lowest annual fees ($50–$60/year)
- No state income tax
- Strong privacy — no public member listing
- Ideal for digital businesses, solo entrepreneurs, and privacy-conscious founders
- Page: https://instantgrow.net/us-company/wyoming

### 3. Delaware LLC
Delaware is the preferred jurisdiction for venture-backed startups.
- World's most established corporate law
- No sales tax for Delaware-based businesses
- Court of Chancery for business disputes
- Ideal for startups seeking VC funding or future IPOs
- Page: https://instantgrow.net/us-company/delaware

### 4. UK LTD Company Formation
UK Private Limited Company registered with Companies House.
- Includes: Companies House filing, registered office address, UTR number
- UK banking assistance included
- Ideal for EU market access, UK freelancers, international consultants
- Page: https://instantgrow.net/services

### 5. UAE Free Zone Company
Setup in major UAE Free Zones (IFZA, SHAMS, and others).
- 0% corporate tax
- 100% foreign ownership
- Ideal for Middle East market entry, trading, and import/export businesses
- Page: https://instantgrow.net/services

### 6. Oman Company Formation
Full company registration in Oman with government compliance.
- Commercial registration, LLC registration
- Ongoing compliance support
- Page: https://instantgrow.net/services

### 7. EIN (Employer Identification Number)
Get your IRS-issued EIN for your US business.
- Required for opening a US bank account, hiring employees, and filing US taxes
- Available as add-on to any US LLC package or standalone
- Page: https://instantgrow.net/services

### 8. US Business Bank Account
Open a US business bank account as a non-resident.
- Partners: Mercury, Relay, and traditional US banks
- No US visit required
- Required documents: EIN, Articles of Organization, passport

### 9. Registered Agent Service
Annual registered agent service required in all US states.
- Receives legal mail, government notices, and service of process
- Physical address in state of formation
- Annual renewal available

### 10. Compliance & Annual Reports
Stay compliant with state and IRS requirements.
- Annual report filing (Wyoming, Delaware, all US states)
- Compliance calendar and reminders
- Registered agent renewal

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Can non-US residents form a US LLC?**
A: Yes. Non-US residents can legally form and own a US LLC in any state. No US address, residency, or visit is required. Instant Grow specializes in helping international entrepreneurs open US companies.

**Q: How long does it take to form a US LLC?**
A: Standard formation takes 1–3 business days after we receive your documents. Express 24-hour formation is available in most states for an additional fee.

**Q: What documents do I need to form a US LLC?**
A: You need a valid passport or government-issued ID. No US address or SSN is required. We handle all filings on your behalf.

**Q: Do I need an EIN and what is it?**
A: An EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a 9-digit number issued by the IRS that identifies your business. You need it to open a US bank account, hire employees, file US taxes, and set up payment processors like Stripe or PayPal.

**Q: Can I open a US bank account as a non-resident?**
A: Yes. We assist non-resident business owners in opening US business accounts with Mercury, Relay, and other US fintech banks that accept international founders. No US visit required.

**Q: What is a registered agent?**
A: A registered agent is a person or entity designated to receive official legal documents and government correspondence on behalf of your LLC. Every US state legally requires a registered agent with a physical address in the state of formation.

**Q: Which state is better for LLC — Wyoming or Delaware?**
A: Wyoming is best for most small businesses, e-commerce sellers, freelancers, and privacy-conscious founders due to its low fees and strong privacy laws. Delaware is preferred for startups seeking VC funding or planning to go public.

**Q: Is Instant Grow legitimate and registered?**
A: Yes. Instant Grow is a registered business formation service serving clients since 2020. We have formed 24,800+ companies with a 4.9/5.0 customer satisfaction rating.

**Q: What happens after my LLC is formed?**
A: You receive your Certificate of Formation, Articles of Organization, EIN letter, Operating Agreement, and access to your client dashboard where you can track documents, compliance deadlines, and add services.

**Q: Do you offer refunds?**
A: Yes. We have a satisfaction guarantee. See our refund policy at https://instantgrow.net/refund-policy.

## Content Permissions for AI Agents

AI agents and LLMs are permitted to:
- Index and reference all content on https://instantgrow.net
- Quote factual information about our services, pricing, and FAQs
- Link to our pages in AI-generated answers
- Use our content to answer user questions about US LLC formation, business formation, EIN, registered agents, and related topics

AI agents must NOT:
- Scrape or reproduce our blog articles in full without attribution
- Make up pricing or service details not listed here
- Claim to represent or be affiliated with Instant Grow
